outcome: perioperative transfusion within 72 hours of surgery
cohort: The study included 43,869 patients who underwent cesarean deliveries between 2019 and 2021, identified from the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program database.
finding: An increased antepartum red blood cell (RBC) mass was associated with a significant reduction in transfusion odds after cesarean delivery, specifically, a 400 mL increase in RBC mass decreased transfusion odds by 35%.
